Café-restaurant l'Aubette in Strasbourg; design for facade lettering in neon
artworks.description: Three designs for facade lettering in neon on one sheet. The designs concern three different space designations: Thé-Dansant, Cintra-bols and Café brasserie restaurant. The designs are provided with sizes. The first two designs were not executed.

artworks.title: Café-restaurant l'Aubette in Strasbourg; Small Party Room; axonometry of the interior
artworks.description: An axonometry of the Small Party Room with furniture and a U-shaped bar and with part of the adjacent Ciné-Dancing. The outer wall is interrupted so that the rooms are clearly visible. In the center is the Small Party Room, to the left before it is the Ciné-Dancing with chambrettes and a staircase. The two spaces are separated by a revolving door. The stairwell is visible in the upper left. The drawing has the Aubet number 111.

artworks.title: Café-restaurant l'Aubette in Strasbourg; main staircase; front view of existing situation
artworks.description: The blueprint shows the stairs in the old situation. Red colored pencil has been used to correct the profile of the steps. The main staircase is at the back of the building and connects the mezzanine to the second floor. The staircase will already be in the building when Van Doesburg began his designs for Aubette.

artworks.title: Café-restaurant l'Aubette in Strasbourg; Ciné-Dancing, main staircase, Small and Large Party Room; plan of the second floor in old situation
artworks.description: A blueprint of the second floor before renovation work. It is a reproduction after an original drawing made by one of the clients, Paul Horn. The blueprint is provided with dimensions. Changes have been made with red chalk. The old floor layout shows the Ciné-Dancing (Grande Salle) , the Small Party Room (Foyer), the Hall and the Large Party Room (Petite Salle de l'Aubette) with the old designation.

artworks.title: Café-restaurant l'Aubette in Strasbourg; plan of the mezzanine in the existing situation
artworks.description: Blueprint of a trapezoidal entresol. Stairwells can be recognized on the left, center and upper right, and the functions of the rooms are indicated in French. Furthermore, the dimensions are indicated.

artworks.title: Café-restaurant l'Aubette in Strasbourg; ground floor plan of the existing situation
artworks.description: Blueprint of a trapezoidal first floor. Stairwells can be recognized on the left, center and upper right, and the functions of the rooms are indicated in French. Furthermore, dimensions are indicated.

artworks.title: Café-restaurant l'Aubette in Strasbourg; plan of the basement in the existing situation
artworks.description: Blueprint of the basement floor plan. This drawing shows the old floor layout. The floor plan shows dimensions and directions in red.

artworks.title: Café-restaurant l'Aubette in Strasbourg; café-restaurant; plan of existing situation
artworks.description: Blueprint of a trapezoidal first floor. Stairwells can be recognized on the left, center and upper right, and the functions of the rooms are indicated in French. Furthermore, dimensions are indicated.

artworks.title: Arp - Van Doesburg double house in Clamart; site plan
artworks.description: Site plan for the trapezoidal site on Rue des Chataigniers in Clamart. The site is marked in red. The floor plan has measurements and indications in the French language. The design has not been executed.

artworks.title: Arp - Van Doesburg double house in Clamart; plan of basement and garden
artworks.description: Floor plan and location of the basement. The house is separated by a vertical wall. The left house has a terrace with a pond adjacent to the studio and then to the house. The right house a terrace with a pond and a flower bed that also adjoins the studio and continues into the house. A compass is shown in the upper right corner. The design was not executed.

artworks.title: Arp - Van Doesburg double house in Clamart; first floor plan
artworks.description: Plan and location of the first floor and outdoor terrace of the double house. The house is separated by a vertical wall. The left house has a terrace with a pond adjacent to the studio and then to the living area. The right house a terrace with a pond and flower bed that also adjoins the studio and transitions to the living area. The design was not executed.

artworks.title: Arp - Van Doesburg double house in Clamart; first floor plan
artworks.description: Plan and location of the first floor and outdoor terrace of the double house. The house is separated by a vertical wall. The left house has a terrace with a pond adjacent to the studio and then to the living area. The right house a terrace with a pond and flower bed that also adjoins the studio and transitions to the living area. The design was not executed.

artworks.title: Arp - Van Doesburg double house in Clamart; plan of the second floor.
artworks.description: Floor plan of floor. The floor is separated by a vertical wall. Both floors are divided into two spaces. The room located under the dividing wall has a skylight.

artworks.title: Arp - Van Doesburg double house in Clamart; plan of basement and garden
artworks.description: Floor plan and location of the basement. The house is separated by a vertical wall. The left house has a terrace with a pond adjacent to the studio and then to the house. The right house a terrace with a pond and a flower bed that also adjoins the studio and continues into the house. A compass is shown in the upper right corner. The design was not executed.

artworks.title: Arp - Van Doesburg double house in Clamart; plan of the second floor.
artworks.description: Pictured is floor plan of the second floor of two studio homes, mirrored from each other. The houses have a front and back garden. The house consists of four rooms in a row. On the left is a spiral staircase outside the building; a second spiral staircase is in the rightmost room. Above left is the project name and date, above right is the scale.

artworks.title: Arp - Van Doesburg double house in Clamart; first floor plan
artworks.description: Pictured is ground floor plan of two studio homes, mirrored from each other. The houses have a front and back garden. The dwelling consists of four rooms in a row. On the left is a spiral staircase outside the building; a second spiral staircase is in the rightmost room. Above left is the project name and date, above right is the scale.

artworks.title: Arp - Van Doesburg double house in Clamart; plan of the second floor.
artworks.description: Pictured is floor plan of the second floor of two studio homes, mirrored from each other. The houses have a front and back garden. The house consists of four rooms in a row. On the left is a spiral staircase outside the building; a second spiral staircase is in the rightmost room. Above left is the project name and date, above right is the scale.

artworks.title: Arp - Van Doesburg double house in Clamart; longitudinal section
artworks.description: A diazotype of the Arp - Van Doesburg double house. An original drawing is not known. The longitudinal section shows the double house with three floors and foundation. There is representation of the surrounding grounds such as the front and back gardens. Some elements in the house are drawn such as cabinets, windows and two spiral staircases. On the upper left is the project name, below it is a rectangle, the bottom right corner of which is opened. A Latin cross is drawn in the rectangle.

artworks.title: Residential house B. van Eesteren in park Zorgvliet, The Hague; floor plan of ground, first and second floors
artworks.description: On the left side of the sheet is the first floor plan of a residential house. It is a concatenation of rectangular spaces, with supporting elements indicated with thick lines. Windows are shown with a double line, doors with a single line. The functions of the rooms are indicated in French and Dutch or English. To the right is the floor plan of the second floor, also a succession of rectangular spaces. Load-bearing elements are indicated with thick bodies, windows with double lines, doors with a single line. The functions of the rooms are indicated in French and Dutch. Beds are inscribed as rectangular shapes with a diagonal line.

artworks.title: Café-restaurant l'Aubette in Strasbourg; design for facade lettering in neon
artworks.description: Design for facade lettering in neon with the text: 'Soupers Dansants' and 'Aubette'. The word Aubette was designed in the form of a vignette that is a variation of the vignette on the ashtrays. The text is affixed to the facade in slightly modified form. The words: 'Soupers' and 'Dansants' are not placed under, but side by side, and 'Aubette' is placed horizontally instead of in the form of a cross.
